name: slopes towards stretch
description: A standing side-leaning stretch that opens up the lats and the side of the torso.
instructions: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
Raise one arm overhead and keep the other hand resting on your hip.
Lean slowly toward the opposite side, lengthening along the raised arm.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Return to upright and switch sides.
